svg.title: Isolation: fixed T1 and T2 input under T4 pressure
svg.desc: T1 and T2 · Identical protected input across the load sweep · Observe throughput, FIFO mean and jitter Only the Type 4 input rate changes along the x-axis. A grey dotted line marks the configured protected rate.

g.text: Isolation: fixed T1 and T2 input under T4 pressure
T1 and T2 · Identical protected input across the load sweep · Observe throughput, FIFO mean and jitter
Points = seed mean | Whiskers = seed min–max
Only the Type 4 input rate changes along the x-axis. A grey dotted line marks the configured protected rate.
